title: ulmus campestris var. latifolia
intro: Ulmus campestris var. latifolia, commonly known as the Dutch Elm, is a deciduous tree species belonging to the family Ulmaceae. The Dutch Elm is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe skin irritations and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include acting as a vulnerary, astringent, and antiseptic, making it effective in wound healing, reducing bleeding, and preventing the growth of bacteria and fungi. The bioactive constituents of Ulmus campestris var. latifolia include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
